The '''Czerka listening outpost''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manned cloaked installation set up by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] in [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Field Trip" />

Drilled deep inside a mountain to the south of the northern [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]], just outside the [[Outlaw's Den]], the installation was protected by Czerka security droids including [[Czerka probe|probes]] equipped with [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field]] detectors.<ref name="Field Trip" />

==History==
In [[3643 BBY]], [[Gayem Leksende]] used the facility as a listening post to spy on [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], when an agent [[Fauler]] was conducting an [[SIS operation on Tatooine|operation]] searching for an old [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research facility]]. The post helped Gayem keep track of republic activity and eventually find the facility himself, however Fauler's associate was able to track an energy signature to the post and destroy its data relay.<ref name="Field Trip" />
